pick.name: shadcn/ui (Radix/Base UI + Tailwind v4)
pick.why: You own the code (no lock-in), Claude Code edits it easily, works in Next, TanStack Start and the Electron renderer

alts.name: Mantine
alts.why: More ready-made complex components (dates, rich inputs) without copy-in

alts.name: HeroUI (web)
alts.why: Sister library to HeroUI Native for visual parity across web and mobile

candidates.name: shadcn/ui (pick)
candidates.verdict: De-facto default for React+Tailwind; owned code.

candidates.name: Mantine
candidates.verdict: Wins for data-heavy admin UIs needing many prebuilt widgets.

candidates.name: HeroUI
candidates.verdict: Wins if you adopt HeroUI Native on mobile and want matching look.

candidates.name: MUI
candidates.verdict: Mature but heavier, Material look, partly paid (MUI X Pro).

decision: shadcn/ui gives owned, Tailwind-based components that the same tokens drive on mobile via Uniwind. Switch to Mantine for admin-heavy B2B apps that need many complex widgets fast.
